```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
```

```{r}
rds_path <- params$rds_path
if (!file.exists(rds_path)) stop("RDS file not found: ", rds_path)
dt <- readRDS(rds_path)
setDT(dt)

# ensure datetime exists (try build from UTC_DATE/UTC_TIME if missing)
if (!("datetime_utc" %in% names(dt)) && all(c("UTC_DATE","UTC_TIME") %in% names(dt))) {
  dt[, UTC_TIME := sprintf("%04s", as.character(UTC_TIME))]
  dt[, datetime_utc := as.POSIXct(paste0(UTC_DATE, " ", UTC_TIME), format = "%Y%m%d %H%M", tz = "UTC")]
}

# make sure source_file exists
if (!("source_file" %in% names(dt))) dt[, source_file := NA_character_]

# sanitize state column
if (!("state" %in% names(dt))) dt[, state := NA_character_]
dt[, state := toupper(state)]

# filter by params$states if provided
if (!is.null(params$states)) {
  wanted <- toupper(params$states)
  dt <- dt[state %in% wanted]
}

# filter by date_range if provided
if (!is.null(params$date_range)) {
  dr <- as.Date(params$date_range)
  if (length(dr) != 2) stop("params$date_range must be length-2 (start,end)")
  dt <- dt[as.Date(datetime_utc) >= dr[1] & as.Date(datetime_utc) <= dr[2]]
}

message("Rows after filtering: ", nrow(dt))
states_present <- sort(unique(na.omit(dt$state)))
message("States present: ", paste(states_present, collapse = ", "))

```

```{r}
# variables to summarize (edit if your file uses different names)
vars_to_summarize <- c("AIR_TEMPERATURE", "PRECIPITATION", "SOLAR_RADIATION",
                       "SURFACE_TEMPERATURE", "RELATIVE_HUMIDITY",
                       "SOIL_MOISTURE_5", "SOIL_TEMPERATURE_5", "WETNESS",
                       "WIND_1_5")
vars_present <- intersect(vars_to_summarize, names(dt))
if (length(vars_present) == 0) stop("None of the target variables present. Available cols: ", paste(names(dt), collapse = ", "))
message("Summarizing: ", paste(vars_present, collapse = ", "))

summarize_numeric <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(x))
  valid <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(valid) == 0L) return(list(n = n, missing_pct = 100, mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, min = NA_real_, p10 = NA_real_, p90 = NA_real_, max = NA_real_))
  list(
    n = n,
    missing_pct = 100 * n_missing / n,
    mean = mean(valid),
    median = median(valid),
    sd = sd(valid),
    min = min(valid),
    p10 = as.numeric(quantile(valid, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
    p90 = as.numeric(quantile(valid, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
    max = max(valid)
  )
}

```

```{r}
# summary function for a numeric vector
summarize_numeric <- function(x) {
  n <- length(x)
  n_missing <- sum(is.na(x))
  valid <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(valid) == 0L) return(list(n = n, missing_pct = 100, mean = NA_real_, median = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, min = NA_real_, p10 = NA_real_, p90 = NA_real_, max = NA_real_))
  list(
    n = n,
    missing_pct = 100 * n_missing / n,
    mean = mean(valid),
    median = median(valid),
    sd = sd(valid),
    min = min(valid),
    p10 = as.numeric(quantile(valid, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
    p90 = as.numeric(quantile(valid, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)),
    max = max(valid)
  )
}
```

```{r}
# We'll compute a tidy table with one row per (state, source_file, variable)
groups <- unique(dt[, .(state, source_file)])
res <- list()
k <- 1
for (i in seq_len(nrow(groups))) {
  st  <- groups$state[i]
  src <- groups$source_file[i]
  sub <- dt[state == st & source_file == src]
  # skip empty groups
  if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
  for (v in vars_present) {
    vec <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub[[v]]))
    s <- summarize_numeric(vec)
    res[[k]] <- data.table(
      state = st,
      source_file = src,
      variable = v,
      n = s$n,
      missing_pct = s$missing_pct,
      mean = s$mean,
      median = s$median,
      sd = s$sd,
      min = s$min,
      p10 = s$p10,
      p90 = s$p90,
      max = s$max
    )
    k <- k + 1
  }
}
summary_dt <- rbindlist(res)
setorder(summary_dt, state, source_file, variable)
summary_dt

```

```{r}
outdir <- file.path(dirname(rds_path), "state_summaries_by_source")
dir.create(outdir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
states_to_write <- sort(unique(summary_dt$state))
for (st in states_to_write) {
  outp <- file.path(outdir, paste0("summary_", st, "_by_source.csv"))
  fwrite(summary_dt[state == st], outp)
}
message("Saved per-state-by-source CSVs to: ", outdir)

```
